_about: SCREENED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL, NOT BY A PERSON. Candidates from the catalog stones' forward reading (legacy2_all.json) that no person screened item by item, run through lab/discovery/screen_rubric.md v1 after the registered comparison in docs/screen_v1.md. Exploratory and not registered. Nothing here enters the product without a person, and under v1 the screen keeps about 86% of what it passes but misses about 44% of what a person keeps.
pool: legacy2_all.json, every causal candidate whose years are not all before the stone (192 of 224; the 32 others are busted by the ordering rule). A random 50 of the 224 were screened by hand in v1 and recorded only as counts, so some of these may have been seen.
